guidelines.content: Explicitly perform the required data reconciliation and report creation in code when no single-tool command exists to generate the final output in the expected format.
Always reference command-specific --help output to determine required argument patterns and avoid misusing positional or named arguments.
Apply instructions from domain contracts or specifications in strict sequential order, resolving each clause before proceeding to downstream filters or computations.

selection: Reviewed from training only, before any held-out evaluation
secondary: Agent turns and rejected service calls; report both even if worse
